comments.content: The query concatenates unsanitized request input into SQL. Use parameterized queries (`?` placeholders) so user-controlled values never appear in the query string.
comments.existing_code:
query = "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = " + user_id
    cursor = db.execute(query)
comments.suggestion_code:
cursor = db.execute(
        "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    )
